title: Investigation of the positive care effect of the Tony app, a digital health application for the self-management of hypertension (hyperTONY)
summary:
The Tony app is aimed at patients with high blood pressure and supports them in independently controlling their blood pressure. The two main pillars of the treatment, which are intended to contribute to lowering blood pressure, are an increase in medication adherence (correct, regular intake of medication) as well as lifestyle coaching in the areas of fitness, nutrition and relaxation. These contents are taught in the Tony app as part of a cognitive-behavioral coaching program. 

The aim of the study is to investigate the extent to which the Tony app is effective in the treatment of high blood pressure. This is to be demonstrated on the basis of an improvement in health status. To this end, the change in systolic blood pressure in the intervention group that uses the app will be examined in comparison with a control group that does not use the app. In addition, the effectiveness of the Tony app in terms of improving quality of life, regular medication adherence and patients' confidence in managing their condition will be examined.

interventions.name: Intervention group (IG). Participants use the Tony app for a total of 6 months in addition to care as usual.
Control group (CG). Participants receive an information brochure on the topic of hypertension in addition to care as usual. At the end of the study, they will get free access to the Tony app.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-	Diagnosed hypertension (≥ 135/85 to < 180/110 mmHg) 
-	Motivation to deal with the disease / make lifestyle changes
-	Use of the provided Beurer upper arm blood pressure monitor
-	Age ≥ 18 Jahre 
-	Device with internet access for using the Tony app 
-	Possession of a valid private e-mail address
Exclusion criteria:
-	Severe hypertension (SBP ≥180mmHg) 
-	Confirmed sleep apnoea 
-	Safety of the patient when using the Tony app not given in the opinion of the doctor (e.g. presence of contraindications, illnesses treated with medication such as cancer or mental problems, planned hospital stays during the study period) 
-	Cardiovascular event within the last 6 months (e.g. stroke, heart attack, cerebral hemorrhage) 
-	Planned hospitalization or currently ongoing medication adjustment of antihypertensives at/during the study baseline (t0)
-	Lack of German language skills 
-	Work in 24-hour shifts (e.g. rescue service, fire department) 
-	Participation in another program or use of another app to lower blood pressure or previous use of the Tony app 
-	Another person in the household uses the app
